description: An opaque burgundy wool tunic reaches below the knees and has restrained geometric woven borders at the neckline, cuffs, and hem. Cream undertunic collar, cuffs, and lower hem show underneath. A plain brown leather belt with a brass-toned buckle and long ornamental-tipped strap secures the waist. Brown trousers and tall brown leather boots are visible. No headgear or armor is worn.
